definitions.explanation: The bright, fresh green of newly sprouted leaves in spring and early summer. A seasonal term evoking the vibrant renewal of nature, particularly associated with late April through May in Japan.

examples.japanese: {新緑|しんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧になった。
examples.english: The season of dazzling new greenery has arrived.

examples.japanese: {新緑|しんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went hiking through the fresh green foliage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{新緑|しんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧{見|み}とれてしまった。
examples.english: The fresh greenery visible from the window was so beautiful that I stopped working and gazed at it.

notes:
USAGE:
{新緑|しんりょく} is a seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) associated with early summer in the traditional Japanese calendar. It specifically refers to the vivid, light green of newly unfurled leaves — distinct from the darker green of mature foliage. The word carries strong aesthetic and emotional resonance in Japanese culture, evoking freshness and vitality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新緑|しんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: the season of fresh greenery
- {新緑|しんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧: the new greenery is dazzling
- {新緑|しんりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in fresh greenery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧: green leaves (similar season, more poetic)
- ⟦{若葉|わかば}→若葉：19659_wakaba⟧: young leaves (emphasis on youth of the leaves)
- {深緑|しんりょく}: deep green (mature foliage, later in summer)
